blocks.heading: Entry Steps, Checked Against Official Notices
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Entry steps, checked against official notices

rows: MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BVSc and AH
NEET UG

In 2026 the General/EWS qualifying line was the 50th percentile (reported as about 213 marks out of 720) and OBC/SC/ST the 40th (about 177). NTA publishes the category-wise table with the result, so read that table, not a coaching-site estimate.
BSc Nursing (Andhra Pradesh)
Appearing in NEET UG

The Dr NTR University of Health Sciences notification for 2026-27 asks for Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English in Class 12, with 45% in science subjects (40% for SC, ST and BC) and appearance in NEET UG 2026. Other states still differ, so read your own state notice.
BPT and BOT
Class 12 marks for 2026-27; NEET planned from 2027-28

NCAHP wrote to UGC in March 2026 that NEET is not mandatory for BPT and BOT in 2026-27, citing logistics, and deferred it to 2027-28. Until then admission uses Class 12 PCB marks: 50% aggregate (40% for reserved categories). Students finishing Class 12 in 2027 should plan on NEET.
Optometry, nutrition and dietetics, radiology and imaging, medical lab technology, dialysis
Reports conflict; check the college and state

A December 2025 NCAHP curriculum report listed several of these under NEET, while a January 2026 report on NCAHP's letter kept medical lab science and radiology on Class 12 scores and applied the 50% PCB rule to optometry. Ask the admitting university which rule it follows this year.
Psychology and psychiatric social work
University or institute test (proposed)
NCAHP's January 2026 proposal kept these outside NEET, though an earlier curriculum report listed applied psychology under NEET. Confirm with the university.
B.Pharm and Pharm.D
State counselling
Examples include AP EAPCET for Andhra Pradesh. Confirm Pharmacy Council of India approval of the college.

blocks.heading: Compare the Practical Paths
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: BiPC career options in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana: what the name changes and what it does not

rows: MBBS, BDS and AYUSH seats
NEET UG score first, then state counselling run by the state health university, with a local-candidate quota on state seats.
Local-status rules, category rules and fee bands, which differ for government, management and NRI seats.
B.Pharm, agriculture, horticulture, veterinary, fisheries
The state's engineering and agriculture entrance (EAPCET) has an agriculture and pharmacy stream open to BiPC students.
Which courses are in the stream this year, and whether a NEET score is also needed for some of them.
BSc life sciences, nursing, allied health
Admission through university or state processes, often on Intermediate marks, with a few central routes through CUET UG.
Whether the college is recognised by the relevant council before you pay any fee.
Non-science pivots (data, psychology, design, business)
Open to BiPC students, usually through CUET UG, the university's own test or direct admission.
Subject rules: a few programmes ask for Maths, which BiPC does not include.
Government BSc Nursing
From a few thousand rupees to about Rs 1.5 lakh tuition a year; under Rs 50,000 for the whole course at many colleges
One fee guide gives this spread. Confirm the exact fee with the college and the counselling authority.
Private BSc Nursing
About Rs 50,000 to Rs 3 lakh a year, so roughly Rs 2 to 12 lakh over four years
Hostel, uniforms, clinical instruments and lab kits are extra. Read the fee schedule for all four years.
Pharmacist pay
Rs 1.2 to 4.1 lakh a year across all experience levels; freshers Rs 1.0 to 4.0 lakh (AmbitionBox, July 2025)
Based on about 23,000 self-reported salaries, so treat it as a broad band, not a promise. Retail and manufacturing differ.
MBBS at a private seat
Varies widely by state and college
Check the state fee regulatory notice and the total across all years before you sign anything.

blocks.heading: Why "Without NEET" Keeps Shifting

items.text: Andhra Pradesh moved its four-year BSc Nursing admission to NEET UG from 2026-27 for government and private colleges, in place of the earlier state test.

supporting: Andhra Pradesh moved its four-year BSc Nursing admission to NEET UG from 2026-27 for government and private colleges, in place of the earlier state test. The NTR University of Health Sciences notification asks applicants to have appeared in NEET UG 2026 and to hold 45 percent in science subjects (40 percent for SC, ST and BC).

blocks.heading: Starting Pay Is Modest
supporting: Starting pay is modest. AmbitionBox lists pharmacists at roughly Rs 1.2 to 4.1 lakh a year across 23,000-plus salary reports (data as of July 2025). Pay climbs when you move into quality, regulatory, research or an owned pharmacy.
